design_philosophy: A premium, cinematic, and masculine grooming experience. The design uses deep charcoal tones to create a moody, expensive atmosphere, punctuated by striking gold accents that draw the eye to interactive elements and key pricing. We avoid 'tech-bro' minimalism by incorporating texture, serif typography for authority, and generous, luxurious spacing.

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-serif text-white

surfaces_and_borders.button_primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-sm px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#C5A028] transition-all
surfaces_and_borders.button_outline: border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-sm px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 transition-all

components_instructions.navbar: Fixed, sticky to top. Uses glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80`). 1px bottom border in `white/10`. Must have the brand name in Playfair Display and a 'Book Now' CTA linking to WhatsApp.
components_instructions.hero: Minimum 90vh height. Use `pexels-18702143` as background with a `bg-black/60` overlay. H1 text centered or left-aligned with a massive Playfair Display font. Two buttons: 'Book via WhatsApp' (Primary) and 'Call Us' (Outline).
components_instructions.offers_banner: A high-contrast strip placed just below the hero or pinned to the top. Use `bg-[#D4AF37] text-black` with bold text: '₹20 OFF YOUR FIRST VISIT — SHOW THIS AT THE COUNTER'.
components_instructions.services_grid: Use Phosphor icons (Scissors, Razor, Drop, Sparkle). Dark cards (`#141414`) with 1px border. On hover, the border transitions to a subtle gold (`border-[#D4AF37]/40`).
components_instructions.pricing_menu: Layout should resemble a high-end restaurant menu. Service name on the left, dotted line or space in the middle, price on the right. Group into categories: Hair, Beard, Face, Combos.
components_instructions.why_choose_us: Grid layout highlighting key USPs: Premium Products, Experienced Barbers, Relaxing Ambience, Hygiene First. Use icons with a gold accent.
components_instructions.gallery: A masonry or staggered grid using the curated unsplash/pexels photos. Give the images a subtle grayscale filter that turns to full color on hover.
components_instructions.testimonials: Bento grid layout. Dark cards. Include the customer photo, a star rating (gold stars), and an authentic-sounding review.
components_instructions.location_and_hours: Two-column layout. Left: Open hours table with 'Sunday Closed' highlighted. Right: Contact details (Phone, Address) and a dark-mode styled Google Map iframe (using CSS filter `invert(90%) hue-rotate(180deg)`).
components_instructions.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right button with WhatsApp icon. `bg-[#25D366] hover:bg-[#20BD5A] text-white rounded-full p-4 shadow-lg z-50`. Links to `https://wa.me/919279857592?text=Hi%20Krishna%20Gents%20Parlour,%20I%20would%20like%20to%20book%20an%20appointment.`

content_details.address: Ram Chand Kurjisar Road, Jasidih, Deoghar, Jharkhand 814142

animations.hover: All interactive elements should subtly translate upwards (`-translate-y-1`) with a soft glow in gold on hover.
animations.scroll: Use `framer-motion` for staggered fade-up entry of sections.

testing.attributes: Ensure all CTAs, navigation links, and service cards have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='whatsapp-floating-button'`).
